info.title: CompSniper Marketplace and Shipping APIs
info.description: Public eBay (including up to 3 years of sold history), Poshmark, Mercari, and TCGplayer marketplace data plus a separate quote-only US shipping-rates product. Shipping quotes separate applicable services from carrier-packaging and content-restricted options, use an independent subscription and quota, and do not consume sold-comps requests or purchased credits.

get.summary: Search up to 3 years of eBay sold history
get.description: Keyword search over eBay sold history going back up to 3 years (eBay's own limit), across eight eBay sites, on every plan including free. Each page of up to 50 listing-level rows uses one request; failed requests are free. Prices are USD. History has its own cap of 20 searches per minute per account (X-History-RateLimit-* headers, 429 history_rate_limited), on top of the plan limit.

schema.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD), no earlier than 3 years before today
Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), no later than today (UTC)
Only listings that sold exactly one unit

get.summary: TCGplayer completed sales and price history
get.description: Full TCGplayer completed-sale history for a product (signed-in data, not the 5 sales shown to signed-out visitors), with optional market price history. One successful call uses one request; identical calls within 24 hours return the saved result.

schema.description: Card or product name (required unless productId is sent)

get.description: Active TCGplayer listings for a product with price, shipping, condition and seller details. One successful call uses one request.

schema.description: Card or product name (required unless productId is sent)

get.summary: Search eBay sold or active listings
get.description: Returns completed eBay sales by default. Set sold=false for current active listings.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Product to search. Supports eBay operators, e.g. minus-sign exclusions ('airpods pro -case').

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum items to return per page. This is a ceiling; fewer valid rows may remain after baseline validation, date filters, or relevance cleanup.

parameters.name: ebaySite
parameters.description: eBay marketplace.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: eBay category id (_sacat).

parameters.name: conditionId
parameters.description: Numeric eBay condition id; overrides itemCondition.

parameters.name: sellerType
parameters.description: Filters labeled sellers on ebay.de, ebay.fr, ebay.it, and ebay.es. Ignored elsewhere; unlabeled EU rows are excluded while filtering.

parameters.name: includeCompleteListing
parameters.description: Sold-search compatibility option. Ignored when sold=false.

parameters.name: sold
parameters.description: true returns completed sales. false returns current active listings with currentPrice, watcherCount, unitsSold, acceptsOffers, and timeLeft when visible.

parameters.name: aspectFilter
parameters.description: JSON object of human-readable eBay facet names. Values may be strings, pipe-delimited strings, or arrays of strings.

parameters.name: exactMatch
parameters.description: When true, removes listings after eBay's explicit Results matching fewer words boundary before relevance cleanup. When the boundary is absent, rows are unchanged. This follows eBay's section split and does not independently prove semantic exactness. false preserves the existing broad-search cache and behavior.

parameters.name: relevance
parameters.description: When true, query-aware deterministic checks remove explicit pricing mismatches before one bounded semantic cleanup stage handles accessories, parts, and wrong models. Explicit query intent is preserved. false disables both relevance stages and returns broad valid matches. Baseline validation of item IDs, item URLs, prices, sold dates, and duplicate IDs always applies.

200.description: Sold listings with price intelligence, or active listings with visible demand signals.

429.description: Inspect the response code. Retry rate_limited after Retry-After; never loop on quota_exceeded.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a rate_limited request. Not used for monthly quota exhaustion.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests in the current one-minute window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current one-minute window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the current one-minute window resets.

502.description: eBay temporarily blocked the upstream request.

get.summary: Browse eBay sold listings by category
get.description: Returns completed eBay sales from one category without requiring a keyword. Uses the same authentication, quota, filtering, response shape, and error contract as /v1/scrape.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Positive numeric eBay category id (_sacat).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum items to return per page. This is a ceiling; fewer valid rows may remain after baseline validation and filtering.

parameters.name: sellerType
parameters.description: EU marketplaces only.

parameters.name: aspectFilter
parameters.description: JSON object of human-readable eBay facets.

200.description: Category sold listings and price summary. keyword is an empty string.

400.description: Missing or invalid categoryId or filters.

429.description: Per-minute rate limit or monthly quota exceeded.

502.description: eBay temporarily blocked the upstream request.

get.summary: Get sold-price intelligence without listing rows
get.description: Runs the same sold search and billing flow as /v1/scrape, but returns only the cleaned price summary, raw comparison evidence, result counts, and cache status.

parameters.name: aspectFilter
parameters.description: JSON object of eBay facet names and values.

429.description: Rate limit or all available billing sources exhausted.

502.description: eBay temporarily blocked the upstream request.

get.summary: Get account quota and purchased-credit usage
get.description: Returns the authenticated account's monthly allowance, current usage, billing period, rate limit, purchased-credit balance, and total available requests.

200.description: Current account usage and credit balance.

post.description: Search up to 20 unique keywords with at most three concurrent workers. If only part of the input fits the selected billing balance, the first keywords run and the remainder receive per-keyword quota_exceeded result events. Each successful keyword consumes one request; failures do not. Results stream as Server-Sent Events and may complete out of order.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay a completed run with the identical request body without repeating searches or consuming quota.

200.description: SSE stream containing start, result, and complete events.

schema.description: Each data field contains one JSON event payload.

409.description: The idempotency key has another body, or a bulk run is already active.

429.description: No keyword can be allocated because the selected monthly and credit balance is empty.

get.description: Download every successful keyword in one CSV, or pass index for one submitted keyword. Requires the same account's bearer credential.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Original zero-based keyword index. Omit for a combined CSV.

404.description: Run or requested successful keyword not found.

post.summary: Submit a sports or trading-card comps batch
post.description: Submit up to 100 cards in one HTTP request. Cards are processed asynchronously and sequentially. Each successfully processed card consumes one normal monthly request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Safely retry a submission without creating a duplicate job.

409.description: Another card batch is already active for this account.

get.summary: Get card batch progress and results

200.description: Current progress, including completed per-card results.

delete.summary: Cancel a queued or running card batch

200.description: Cancellation requested or existing terminal status returned.

post.summary: Start an asynchronous Max Mode search
post.description: Searches up to 100 eBay result pages in the background. Each successful page uses one monthly request, then one purchased credit after monthly quota is exhausted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Return the previously created job when a submission is retried.

400.description: Invalid request body or search options.

409.description: Another Max Mode job is active for this account.

get.summary: Poll Max Mode progress or results

200.description: Current job progress or terminal result.

404.description: Job not found for this account.

delete.summary: Cancel a queued or running Max Mode job

200.description: Cancellation requested or existing terminal status returned.

404.description: Job not found for this account.

get.summary: Download a signed Max Mode CSV
get.description: Downloads the stored job result using the signed token returned for download or email delivery. The token itself authorizes this URL.

Returns one native page of public Poshmark sold listings. Authentication, rate limits, monthly quota, purchased credits, request IDs, and cache headers match the other CompSniper endpoints. Each successful page uses one CompSniper request, including enrich=true. The native page ceiling is 48 listings.

schema.description: Page number. Each page returns up to 48 items.
Condition filter. 'nwt' = New With Tags only.

Adds public seller location, approximate sold-count evidence, and average ship time. Sold date, listed date, colors, description, category, and condition are already returned when present in the native search response. This still uses one CompSniper request.

parameters.name: enrich
parameters.description: Adds public seller location, approximate sold-count evidence, and average ship time. Sold date, listed date, colors, description, category, and condition are already returned when present in the native search response. This still uses one CompSniper request.

totalItems.description: Number of items returned in this response (up to 48)

hasNextPage.description: Whether more pages of results are available.

title.example: Louis Vuitton Neverfull MM Damier Ebene

shippingCost.description: Reserved for item-level shipping evidence. null when Poshmark does not expose it.

soldAt.description: Public ISO timestamp when Poshmark marked the item sold.

listedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the item was first published.

daysToSell.description: Days between listedAt and soldAt. null when either date is missing.

commentsCount.description: Public comment count when exposed by Poshmark search.

shareCount.description: Public share count when exposed by Poshmark search.

sellerSoldCount.description: Approximate public seller sold count. Requires enrich=true.

sellerAvgShipTime.description: Seller's average ship time in days. Requires enrich=true.

scrapedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the listing was scraped

503.description: Server busy: concurrency limit reached; retry shortly

get.summary: Search Mercari sold or active listings
get.description: Returns one page of public Mercari sold or active listings through a managed anonymous guest session. Authentication, rate limits, monthly quota, purchased credits, request IDs, and cache headers match the other CompSniper endpoints. Each successful page uses one CompSniper request and returns up to 100 items.

schema.description: Page number, maps to offset = (page - 1) * count
Sort order. recentlySold maps to Mercari's current Recently sold option. mostPopular is accepted as a compatibility alias for recentlySold.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort order. recentlySold maps to Mercari's current Recently sold option. mostPopular is accepted as a compatibility alias for recentlySold.

schema.description: true = sold listings (default), false = active listings

503.description: Temporary Mercari connection failure (upstream_unavailable) or exhausted search capacity (server_busy). Failed requests do not consume allowance. Retry after the Retry-After delay.

post.description: Returns quote-only shipping estimates for a US origin ZIP, US destination ZIP, package weight, and dimensions. Applicable services are returned in rates. Carrier-packaging and content-restricted services are returned in conditionalRates unless the caller explicitly confirms the requirement. Preserves retail and eBay discounted prices when available. Requires a separate Shipping Rates subscription and consumes one shipping request only when usable applicable rates are returned.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays a completed identical quote without consuming another shipping request. Use a new key for a different request body.

200.description: Usable shipping-rate estimates. One separate shipping request is consumed unless this is an idempotent replay.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid route or package details.

403.description: Credential lacks access or the account has no active Shipping Rates subscription.

409.description: Idempotency key conflict or an identical request with that key is still running.

422.description: No shipping services were available. No shipping request is consumed.

429.description: Shipping rate limit or independent monthly shipping quota exceeded.

502.description: Shipping-rate source is temporarily unavailable. No shipping request is consumed.

503.description: Shipping-rate capacity is temporarily busy. No shipping request is consumed.

get.description: Returns the authenticated account's separate Shipping Rates plan, quota, usage, rate limit, and billing period.

200.description: Current independent Shipping Rates entitlement and usage.

403.description: Credential lacks access to account usage.

CreditSource.name: X-Credit-Source
CreditSource.description: Omit to use temporary carryover first, then monthly quota, then purchased credits. Set to credits to spend a purchased credit directly. Failed searches are not charged.

bearerAuth.description: Send your API key as 'Authorization: Bearer cs_live_...'.

totalItems.description: Valid items on this page after baseline validation and filtering.

summary.description: Sold-price intelligence. null for active searches.

PriceSummary.description: Deterministic price intelligence over the returned sold items.

count.description: Items with a usable sold price.

p25.description: Lower bound of the realistic range.

p75.description: Upper bound of the realistic range.

rolloverBalance.description: Unused monthly requests carried from a full-price upgrade. These expire at the next renewal.

totalAvailable.description: Carryover plus monthly requests remaining plus purchased credits.

type.description: Select custom unless the shipment will use the exact named carrier packaging.

mediaMailEligible.description: Set true only when the contents qualify under USPS Media Mail standards.

fastest.description: True when this applicable service has the shortest maximum delivery window. Ties are allowed.

totalRates.description: Services currently applicable to the submitted package and content declarations.

totalConditionalRates.description: Additional services requiring specific carrier packaging or eligible contents.

conditionId.description: Best-effort mapping of a known localized eBay condition label.

sellerType.description: Labeled seller classification on EU marketplaces.

bestOfferAccepted.description: true when eBay marked an accepted Best Offer; null when no accepted-offer marker was detected. eBay does not disclose the accepted amount.

productRating.description: eBay catalog star rating shown on the result card. This describes the product, not the seller.

productReviewCount.description: Number of eBay catalog ratings behind productRating.

ActiveItem.description: A current eBay listing returned when sold=false. Demand fields are null when eBay does not show them on the search card.

currentPrice.description: Current asking or bid price as a decimal string.

currentPriceMax.description: Upper bound when eBay displays a price range.

timeLeft.description: Raw localized time remaining when visible.

productRating.description: eBay catalog star rating shown on the result card. This describes the product, not the seller.

productReviewCount.description: Number of eBay catalog ratings behind productRating.

keywords.description: Case-insensitively deduplicated product keywords. Each keyword may contain at most 300 characters.

BulkSearchOptions.description: Shared page-one options applied independently to every keyword.

CardInput.description: Supply an exact keyword, or structured fields. subject is universal; player and character are convenient aliases.

reference.description: Your inventory or correlation ID, echoed in the result.

keyword.description: Exact eBay search keyword. When present it overrides generated structured-field keywords.

count.description: Maximum sold comps inspected per card. Compact output is capped at 60.

exactMatch.description: Remove eBay's explicit Results matching fewer words section for each card search.

outputMode.description: compact also returns compact sold-listing rows, including bestOfferAccepted, and is limited to 25 cards with count <= 60.

upgradeUrl.description: Present when processing stopped because the account quota was exhausted.

bestOfferAccepted.description: true when eBay marked an accepted Best Offer; null otherwise. The accepted amount is not disclosed.

retry_after.description: Seconds before a temporary rate_limited request may be retried.

subscription_url.description: Shipping Rates plan URL for shipping_subscription_required or shipping_quota_exceeded.
